scope: Targeted static review of core work/session contracts, Beads CLI and direct Dolt writers, native launch/end/state/recycle/housekeeping, pool and cascade dispatch, persona application and purview, MCP bridge/escalations, nonce/auth/tenant/bind controls, event delivery and selected board/client code, plus selected test assertion bodies. Not every-line or full external-orchestrator/spec-engine/backend/migration/security/browser/runtime certification. Non-test Go call inventories are labeled as such.

lifecycle_review.create: HTTP decode and optional milestone naming, adapter write, separate history append and cascade/reconcile; CLI wrapper and SQL transactional writer separately traced; committed response-error boundaries retained.
lifecycle_review.select: Pool unstarted/runnable/dispatch-ready/persona/direct-blocker filters, workspace snapshot conflicts, score and local dispatch gate; named HTTP start separate and no assignee filter in pool ready body; gate completion has no caller in inspected internal non-test Go inventory.
lifecycle_review.claim: Native local map guard after pane spawn, best-effort loser kill; no atomic tracker claim, durable reservation or multi-instance authority; SQL and CLI general patches omit revision/owner/attempt conditions.
lifecycle_review.progress: Task patches, bridge state, transcript interfaces and consult output; prompt context is instructive; default AttachEvidence denied; no mandatory result envelope or ownership-fenced worker updates.
lifecycle_review.review: DoD informational, clean worktree not accepted artifact, persona purview conditional; consult apply check/effect/mark separated and concurrent duplication possible; no globally enforced qualified acceptance.
lifecycle_review.complete: bead-done marks runtime ready after clean check, not tracker/remote/test verification; wrappers separately roll up terminal leaves including cancellation; generic task status writer remains independent.
lifecycle_review.cancel: End terminal checks and pane membership; shared-pane siblings preserved; termination/cleanup best effort, no external effect rollback; pause backend-dependent and recycle several best-effort effects.
lifecycle_review.recover: Process-local session/escalation/nonce maps constructed empty; retry caches sequential and nondurable with concurrent miss gap; idle/reconcile not task lease, missing native heartbeat/active-turn producers in inspected inventory; SSE no replay or reconnect snapshot invalidation, durable logs not active-attempt restoration.
